learningObjective.stringValue: Explain how early Filipino barangays were organized, including leadership, social roles, customs, and cooperation in community life.

introduction.stringValue: What makes people a community, beyond living near one another? Relationships, responsibilities and cooperation help us understand everyday life. Different communities could organise these in different ways.

lessonRecap.stringValue: Barangay life involved local leadership, different social roles, customs and cooperation. Communities could organize themselves in different ways.

storyContent.stringValue: Welcome, young traveler! You have arrived in an early Filipino community. In this mission, you will explore how people lived, worked, traded, and organized their community.

introduction.stringValue: How do resources, skills and agreements make exchange useful? Food and useful objects come from work and resources. Exchange helps us explore how people with different products meet needs.
